Sound quality data, one record per show

Source: R/data.R
gid_sound_quality.Rd

Sound quality data, one record per show

Usage

gid_sound_quality

Format

dataframe with one row for each show in the Fugazi Live Series data.

gid

show id

sound_quality

Sound quality rating: Excellent, Very Good, Good, or Poor.

Source

https://www.dischord.com/fugazi_live_series

Provenance

Derived-cleaned. Produced by Repeatr_1.

Examples

gid_sound_quality
